主要内容: PHI, Inc. (OTC: PHIIQ; PHIKQ) completed its Chapter 11 debt restructuring on July 30, 2019, reducing its debt by approximately $500 million. The restructuring confirmed by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of Texas resulted in former unsecured creditors owning 10,000% of the company's equity, subject to dilution. The company also secured a $225 million five-year term loan and received new equity capital from former unsecured creditors. Leadership transition occurred with Al A. Gonsoulin retiring as CEO and Lance Bospflug becoming the new CEO. The restructuring improved the company's balance sheet and aims to enhance innovation and growth in the aviation services industry. PHI, Inc. operates over 240 aircraft across more than 70 global locations, serving the offshore Oil and Gas, Air Medical, and Technical Services sectors. The company employs approximately 2,200 personnel worldwide and has expanded its operations to 43 foreign countries. The restructuring plan includes measures to enhance liquidity and operational performance, though it remains subject to various risks and uncertainties, including the ability to secure additional capital and retain key personnel and customer relationships.
